chemistry.question: Compare normality and molarity for sulfuric acid in acid-base titration. Use two sentences.

response.answer: Molarity measures the concentration of H₂SO₄ in moles per liter, whereas normality measures the concentration of reactive equivalents of H⁺ ions per liter of solution. Because sulfuric acid is a diprotic acid that donates two H⁺ ions per molecule during complete neutralization, its normality is always twice its molarity (N = 2M).
